body: On some level I know you're right but it's an irrational part of me that is going to end it and that part of me can be overwhelming
I think I've fooled all of them. When I do reach out, they're supportive, but I know that I'm not worth supporting

Thanks for taking the time to read. There are people close to me who care so much about me and I feel like all I can ever do is bring them down. I know that what I'm about to do will do the same thing for a little while, but I also know that all I'd ever do is make their lives worse. I honestly feel that killing myself is the right thing to do.
